testCase.name: [dev] S01 Hospital card shows identity at a glance and opens that patient's Pre-Round view

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S01 「医院卡片一眼看到身份信息，点开是这个病人的 Pre-Round 页面」 Hospital card shows identity at a glance and opens that patient's Pre-Round view

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U2 The card shows the chief diagnosis on Hospital cards only; a Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3；UAT TC-03）
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 5）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Signed-in @roundai.test physician with the standard fixture: one Hospital patient (age 72, room 4B-xx, diagnosis Community-acquired pneumonia, no badge set) and one Nursing Home resident

When Open the Hospital list, look at the card, tap the card

Then The card shows the name, the room and the diagnosis and the Follow-up badge; the tap opens that patient's chart on the Pre-Round tab

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 (list) mustContain 'Open chart for <name>' (the card's own button name, list only), 'Room 4B-', the diagnosis, 'Follow-up', mustNotContain 'pre-round notes' (chart only); cp2 (chart) mustContain name, 'pre-round notes' and 'Admission status' (the chart-header control), mustNotContain 'Encounter Notes'. One patient per context, so this is not evidence for U8; …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U22；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S01

Hospital card shows identity at a glance and opens that patient's Pre-Round view

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U22.verdict.json), unit U22 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 81 turns, 275 s, $0.62.

Plan: unit U22 (#22, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Lists and cards, both contexts. Same legacy seed, same list screens. All four only look, open a chart, or flip In Today and flip it back. S13 (nothing entered is invented) runs first, before anything is opened. EFS S12 runs second: it turns In Today off and on and its checkpoint 4 checks the restore, so the parts after it start from a checked state. TC-01 S02 runs last, because its final tap ('tap it once more so it is back as it was') has no checkpoint after it. Runs together with TC-01/S13, EFS/S12, TC-01/S02.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #22, U22; checked: yes): Fail (S02 only, product) — S02: NH card shows the diagnosis on Today's Visits and All Residents — same root cause as U01 (cluster C1: NH card diagnosis, TFA-92581 AC 3 / UAT TC-03 + TC-01). S13, EFS S12 (empty Today's Visits message + how to add), S01 pass
